title: Gold Price Crash Explained 😱 Sona ₹44,000 Sasta Kyun Hua? | Hindi
description:
Gold price crash explained in Hindi! January 2026 mein sona ₹1,75,340 (10 gram, 24K) tha, aur 18 November ko ₹1,31,095 — karib ₹44,000 sasta. Aakhir aisa kya hua? 😱

Is video mein: duniya mein gold kyun gira (strong dollar, Fed rate hike ka dar, oil), Bharat mein phir bhi mehenga kyun (import duty 15%, hallmark charges), shaadi ke season par asar, aur aage kya ho sakta hai.

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 परिचय
0:21 सोना कितना गिरा?
0:55 दुनिया में क्यों गिरा?
1:50 भारत में महंगा क्यों?
2:26 जेब और शादियों पर असर
3:03 आगे क्या?

Aap abhi sona kharidoge ya intezaar karoge? Comment mein batao! 👇

⚠️ Ye video sirf jaankari ke liye hai, financial advice nahi.

Sources: World Gold Council, Reuters, IANS, ANI, Business Today, Goodreturns, Trading Economics (November 2026).
